To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) LIA is the first system that enables users to teach an intelligent personal agent new action sequences using natural language instruction; (2) LIA can generalize across commands taught by different users, and can perform novel commands that have not been taught to it, by combining taught commands in a novel manner; and (3) users find LIA to be an effective tool for performing email tasks, and voluntarily teach new commands to LIA.

LIA, an intelligent personal agent, can be taught new commands in natural language, which it can then execute, and that users voluntarily teach it new commands, which significantly reduce task completion times.
we have developed an intelligent personal agent called the LIA that can be taught new tasks using natural language instruction.
